changes.name: SkyboundPetCrafting
changes.source:
local RS=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local remote=RS:WaitForChild("SkyboundCraftPet")
local function samePets(inv,name)
 local out={};for _,v in ipairs(inv:GetChildren()) do if v:IsA("StringValue") and v.Value==name then table.insert(out,v) end end;return out
end
remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(p,name)
 if type(name)~="string" then return end
 local inv=p:FindFirstChild("Pets");if not inv then return end
 local matches=samePets(inv,name);if #matches<3 then return end
 for i=1,3 do matches[i]:Destroy() end
 local shiny=Instance.new("StringValue");shiny.Name="Shiny "..name;shiny.Value="Shiny "..name;shiny:SetAttribute("Shiny",true);shiny.Parent=inv
end)
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(p)
 local inv=p:FindFirstChild("Pets");if inv then inv.ChildAdded:Connect(function(v) if v:GetAttribute("Shiny") then v:SetAttribute("PowerBonus",2) end end) end
end)

changes.name: SkyboundPetCraftUI
changes.source:
local Players=game:GetService("Players");local RS=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage");local p=Players.LocalPlayer
local gui=Instance.new("ScreenGui");gui.Name="PetCraftUI";gui.ResetOnSpawn=false;gui.Parent=p:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local b=Instance.new("TextButton");b.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(130,46);b.Position=UDim2.new(0,298,1,-70);b.Text="CRAFT";b.TextScaled=true;b.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold;b.Parent=gui
local f=Instance.new("Frame");f.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(430,380);f.Position=UDim2.new(.5,-215,.5,-190);f.Visible=false;f.Parent=gui
local title=Instance.new("TextLabel");title.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,60);title.BackgroundTransparency=1;title.Text="CRAFT 3 DUPLICATES → SHINY";title.TextScaled=true;title.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBlack;title.Parent=f
local list=Instance.new("ScrollingFrame");list.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(15,70);list.Size=UDim2.new(1,-30,1,-85);list.AutomaticCanvasSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y;list.CanvasSize=UDim2.new();list.Parent=f
local layout=Instance.new("UIListLayout");layout.Padding=UDim.new(0,6);layout.Parent=list
local function rebuild()
 for _,x in ipairs(list:GetChildren()) do if x:IsA("TextButton") then x:Destroy() end end
 local inv=p:FindFirstChild("Pets");if not inv then return end;local counts={}
 for _,v in ipairs(inv:GetChildren()) do counts[v.Value]=(counts[v.Value] or 0)+1 end
 for name,count in pairs(counts) do local x=Instance.new("TextButton");x.Size=UDim2.new(1,-8,0,48);x.Text=name.."  x"..count..(count>=3 and "   → CRAFT SHINY" or "   (NEED 3)");x.TextScaled=true;x.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold;x.Parent=list;x.Activated:Connect(function() if count>=3 then RS.SkyboundCraftPet:FireServer(name);task.wait(.3);rebuild() end end) end
end
b.Activated:Connect(function() f.Visible=not f.Visible;if f.Visible then rebuild() end end)
